text:
IncidentBot: PAGER: billing-metering-anomaly detected — token-count delta >2% vs expected baseline across emitters (alert_id: BM-2026-3591). Affected pipeline: ingest-proxy -> token-aggregator. Runbook: https://redwood-infra/runbooks/billing-metering

maria (oncall-sre): Oncall acked. I'll triage root cause and check emitter/backpressure. Starting checklist: 1) check ingest-proxy queues 2) check token-aggregator offsets 3) confirm customer flags.

alex (billing): Adding context: saw a jump in late-window emits starting ~2026-03-17T08:12:xxZ. Diff shows token counts undercounting by ~2.4% from redis emitter replica 2. Logs: `ERROR emitter/ack_timeout shard=2 offset=234523`.

sam (eng-ml): tagging because this might be related to the KV-cache TTL change rolled out yesterday. Not sure but sequence length heuristics changed.

maria (oncall-sre): Quick commands: `kubectl -n billing logs deploy/ingest-proxy -c emitter --since=30m | grep ERROR | tail -n 50` and `redis-cli -h red-emit-02 info replication`. Running now.

alex (billing): Pasting snippet from aggregator metrics: 
```
window: 2026-03-17T08:00-08:15 UTC
expected_tokens: 1,234,567
observed_tokens: 1,205,432
delta: -29,135 (-2.36%)
emitter_backlog_ms: 14,200
emit_retries: 0 -> 17
```
Seems like delayed emits rather than permanent loss. emit_retries spiked after a short network blip to redis master.

leah (support): Customer impact: alerting system flagged overage-safety for 3 customers (acct-332, acct-998, acct-412). No invoices sent yet. Customers posted support tickets referencing "weird usage spikes". Not yet billing-visible overcharges, but flags could trigger downstream notifications.

tina (product-ops): @leah prioritize acct-332 and acct-998 — both are enterprise. Prepare a proactive note if this persists.

maria (oncall-sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) force failover redis replica -> promote replica 3 (in progress), 2) pause emitter batching at ingress (`emitter.batch_size=1`) to reduce KV TTL thrash, 3) enable fallback aggregator path (read-from-write-ahead) to reduce windowing delay. Executing step 1 now.

alex (billing): I kicked off a backfill job to reprocess late windows: `python3 scripts/backfill_tokens.py --start=2026-03-17T07:50 --end=2026-03-17T08:20 --dry-run=false` — monitoring DB write throughput.

sam (eng-ml): Observed that the KV cache TTL ramp dropped effective cache hits by 8% after the policy change; that could increase reads to emitter and create contention. Flagging for rollback if mitigation fails.

maria (oncall-sre): Redis promote finished, emitter backlog reduced from 14.2s -> 1.6s within ~4m. Aggregator window lag trending down.

alex (billing): After backfill start: observed_tokens rising, delta now -3,412 (-0.28%) for the latest window. Still watching commit rate to billing DB.

leah (support): Notifying customers: sent templated FYI to acct-332 and acct-998: "We detected a transient metering delay that may have flagged usage incorrectly; we are investigating and will notify if adjustments are needed."

tina (product-ops): Good. Please include estimated ETA for resolution in next customer update.

maria (oncall-sre): Current status: mitigations applied, primary service stable. Action items:
- alex: finish backfill and confirm rebalance writes completed (PRIORITY)
- sam: assess KV TTL rollback feasibility and risk (by +30m)
- leah: keep customer comms warm and update if backfill corrects flags
- maria: monitor for 60m then close incident if no regressions

alex (billing): Backfill completed for target window, reconcile report shows tokens recovered. Running final consistency check: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing.reconciles WHERE window='2026-03-17T08:00'` comparing to expected baseline.

maria (oncall-sre): Final check: delta now within +/-0.05% for past 3 windows. No new overage notifications triggered.

leah (support): Customer update sent: "Issue resolved; any flags were transient and we've reconciled counts. No billing action required. Reach out if you see anything unusual"

sam (eng-ml): I'll prepare a postmortem note outlining KV TTL policy change and recommend a gradual ramp + circuit-breaker for emitter pressure.

maria (oncall-sre): Closing ops loop: will file incident doc and link to retrospective. If anyone sees fresh anomalies ping here or escalate. :white_check_mark:
